description:
On the far northeastern edge of the United States, where the Atlantic greets the first sunrise in the country, lies Maine—the State of the Rising Sun.
Here, people have long lived in close harmony with nature, which continues to shape everyday life.
fulltitle: MAINE: Living in the State of the Rising Sun
